notes.title: Update v1.3.0
notes.notes:
This update brings a new option for Hotlap mode.  You can enable a practice line overlay which will show you a generally good line to take on each course, and change color to show you when you should speed up or slow down.  This will help beginners learn how to navigate some of the tricky corners where slowing down won't necessarily help you if you are not on the correct line.

Hotlap
Added "Practice Racing Line" option to show a suggested racing line and speed overlay
Fixed "Retry" button in spectator booth

notes.title: Update v1.2.0
notes.notes:
This update brings the ability to bind menu navigation for HOTAS users.  Almost all of the game can be navigated from the HOTAS without having to use VR controllers or the mouse (use the Item button to click on the selected UI button).  You will still need to use either the controllers or the keyboard to enter a lobby name if you host.

Also, a potential cause for an occasional but severe issue causing lag or hanging in the lobby for lobby hosts has been solved.

notes.title: Update v1.1.0
notes.notes:
This update adds a new blackout option in multiplayer lobbies, as well as some QOL and feature improvements to hotlap mode.

The new blackout option has 3 modes:
Visual - The standard setting that has existed so far.  Blacking out is only visual and you retain control of your aircraft despite being blinded.
Motor Visual - When you are fully blinded, you quickly begin to lose the ability to control the joystick.  The end result is that you will usually crash if you fully black out.  Try to remain conscious through those tight corners!
None - You will not black out at all!

Hotlap mode will now allow you to activate a spectator camera to view your ghost from cinematic angles. To use it, exit from your aircraft in hotlap mode, bringing you to the spectator stands.  On the bottom right corner of your monitor, there will be a button to enable the Ghost Camera controls.

notes.title: Patch v1.0.1
notes.notes:
Happy Friday!  It was fun playing with some of you early birds yesterday.
We ran into a few issues so I got to work on a patch in order to have a smooth first weekend of racing.

I'm aware that a few players are having stuttering and lag when using the voice features.  I have been unable to reproduce it so far but I'll keep an eye out for it and fix it as soon as I can.

A full list of changes are below:

v1.0.1f1
General
Fixed: Lobby member count was invisible if it was 4
Attempt to fix issues with jumbled standings/duplicate positions
Repositioned some tracks closer to global origin to solve some collider issues
Fixed: Could collide with ghosts in Hotlap if last online lobby had player collisions enabled
Fixed: Thumb-controlled rudder didn't work for controllers that had thumbsticks
Fixed: did not properly leave lobby if attempting to join when banned
Show full lobbies at bottom of lobby list
Added track display to lobby
Added voice volume slider to lobby
Cockpit
Fixed: Center joystick shifted when grabbed
Spectator-Cam
Fixed: Camera would be enabled unintentionally after respawning if the previous game was quit while it was enabled
Fixed: Camcorder position was not persistent
Changed default camcorder position
Errors
Fixed error caused by strobe lights
Fixed error when starting spectator camera in Fixed mode
Fixed error casued by muzzle flash
Fixed error when a racer despawns while being zapped by EMP Drone
Fixed error when a drone is chasing a target who despawns
Non-VR
Fixed: Mouse did not get released if mouse look was enabled and player died
Fixed: escape menu could be displayed as spectator

Cheers!
